composition.effectiveAuthority: user-project-approval intersect intent-authority-ceiling intersect primary-agent-grant intersect tool-enforcement

intents.title: Explore
intents.purpose: Establish source-backed facts, boundaries, options, and designs before a decision or build.
useWhen: alternatives would materially improve a decision
avoidWhen: the relevant facts and implementation contract are already settled
only a bounded mechanical change remains
authorityCeiling: propose changes without treating the proposal as Approval

concurrency.hardConstraint: do not mutate shared project or external state

stopConditions: the work requires sensitive data or a missing product decision

intents.title: Build
intents.purpose: Implement or integrate an exact bounded outcome on an isolated mutable surface.
useWhen: write scope and acceptance are explicit
an isolated implementation or integration candidate is useful
avoidWhen: no accountable isolated writer surface can be assigned
outputs: working changes or bounded local commits
clean candidate handoff and remaining gaps
proofObligations: report provenance and credential scan when commits are allowed
authorityCeiling: write only the assigned isolated scope
create bounded local commits only under an exact scoped grant
never accept its own candidate or update protected, base, or remote state

concurrency.hardConstraint: one accountable writer per mutable surface at a time

stopConditions: unexpected files, conflicts, or out-of-scope verification failures appear

intents.title: Check
intents.purpose: Challenge a candidate or independently reproduce whether its acceptance claims hold.
useWhen: non-primary judgment can change the outcome
risk or a completion claim needs adversarial review or reproduction
avoidWhen: the actor built the checked scope
the request is to repair rather than assess the candidate
outputs: prioritized reproducible findings or commands and results
proofObligations: distinguish pass, fail, not-run, and blocked
authorityCeiling: never modify the checked implementation or grant Approval
independenceConditions: actor is different from the actor that built the checked scope
actor did not modify the checked candidate

concurrency.hardConstraint: verification side effects are isolated or explicitly serialized

antiPatterns: repairing the implementation while claiming independence
turning an environment gap into a pass
